hooks.text: 六英雄自动战斗，重生后可在后台全员管理
hooks.excerpt: Your heroes automatically move, attack, heal, and perform other actions, ensuring nonstop battles! By progressing through Rebirth , you can eventually manage all heroes simultaneously in the background.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 六英雄共享技能，还能捕捉培养百余怪物
hooks.excerpt: Share unique skills among your six heroes to create dynamic strategies. Capture over 100 monsters and enhance their abilities through leveling up to strengthen your team.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Rebirth强化英雄，Ascension重置整个世界
hooks.excerpt: Rebirth your heroes to gain powerful progression boosts, starting fresh but stronger each time. Prestige the entire world through Ascension , unlocking even more content and stronger boosts.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 商店价格会无理由暴涨。

excerpts.excerpt: the items on the store (not the epic coins) abysmally growth without any reason
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 自动化被付费货币限制，导致需要大量微操。

excerpts.excerpt: needs tons of micro management unless you pay for the currency to actually be able to do automation
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 世界转生后游戏可能卡死。

excerpts.excerpt: Game gets stuck after you do a world ascension.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 系统深度与复杂度超出预期。

excerpts.excerpt: Surprisingly deep and complex idle RPG.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 作为挂机游戏的第二代作品较有趣。

excerpts.excerpt: 比较有趣的挂机游戏第二代
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 充满怪物与探索内容的幻想世界受到喜欢。

excerpts.excerpt: 一个充满怪物和有待探索的幻想世界nice
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
